news.title: FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ Match Schedule unveiled
news.lede: The FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ is just 306 days away, and the much-anticipated match schedule for the tenth edition of the tournament has now been confirmed. FIFA has unveiled the match schedule for the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™, confirming when and where all 64 fixtures will be played across Brazil’s eight vibrant Host Cities. All eight Host Cities will host at least seven matches, including a minimum of one knockout fixture. Brasília, Porto Alegre, Recife and Salvador will host matches until the Round of 16.

news.title: Rio de Janeiro to host 2027 Women’s World Cup final
news.lede: Fifa unveiled the full match schedule for the 2027 Women's World Cup in Brazil, with 32 teams set to compete across eight cities. (Fifa pic) LONDON: The 2027 Women's World Cup final will take place at Rio de Janeiro's Maracana Stadium, Fifa announced Thursday as it unveiled the entire match schedule for the competition in Brazil. Thirty-two teams will compete in eight cities, with each location hosting at least seven matches and a minimum of one knockout game. In all, 64 matches will be played.

news.title: Maracanã to host opening game and final at next year’s Women’s World Cup
news.lede: Stadium has hosted two men’s World Cup finals. Arena Itaquera in São Paulo will host 10 matches. The Maracanã in Rio de Janeiro will host the opening game and the final of next year’s Women’s World Cup. The 78,838-capacity stadium, which hosted the finals of the 1950 and 2014 men’s World Cups as well as the finals of the Olympic football competitions in 2016, will be the venue for Brazil’s opening Group A match on 24 June, before staging the final on 25 July.

news.title: FIFA unveils 2027 Women’s World Cup schedule
news.lede: FIFA has unveiled the schedule for the 2027 Women’s World Cup in Brazil, with the Maracanã in Rio de Janeiro set to host both the opening match and the final of the tournament. The competition will run from June 24 to July 25, 2027, with 64 matches to be played across eight host cities. It will be the 10th edition of the Women’s World Cup and the first to be staged in South America. Hosts Brazil will open the tournament at the iconic Maracana on June 24 before playing their remaining group-stage matches at Arena Itaquera in São Paulo on June 29 and the Estádio Nacional in Brasília on July 4.

news.title: Tom Bischof talks about his summer break, watching the World Cup from home
news.lede: Tom Bischof has a remarkable mindset at such a young age: he played less than he would’ve liked for Bayern Munich last season and was unceremoniously left out of Germany’s squad for the World Cup. For the new season, he has locked in completely but allowed some time for himself. “Now and then I like to not watch any football, but obviously you can’t go completely without TV – I did watch a few World Cup matches,” Bischof said in an interview with Säbener 51 (as captured by X account @iMiaSanMia). “Still, I was able to switch off.

news.title: Football: Soccer-World Cup surprise package Cape Verde name Bettencourt as coach
news.lede: Aug 20 (Reuters) - ⁠Cape Verde have named Humberto Bettencourt ⁠as coach, replacing Bubista who ‌took them to the round-of-32 at the World Cup last month. The 51-year-old Bettencourt was previously ​assistant coach of the ⁠small island nation ⁠team, who were one of the revelations ⁠of ‌the tournament in North America, going out in extra ⁠time to Argentina after getting past ​the first ‌round on their debut. Bettencourt has worked ⁠with ​the team over the last six years. No details of any contract terms ⁠were announced by the Cape ​Verdean FA.
